Clear a project's regenerable cache

Source: R/project.R
clear_cache.Rd

Deletes everything in the project's cache/ zone and nothing else – the precious raw/ and derived processed//validation/ zones are never touched. Safe to call when the cache is already empty.

Usage

clear_cache(project, quiet = FALSE)

Arguments

project

A polis_project.

quiet

Suppress the success message. Default FALSE.

Value

The project, invisibly.

Examples

proj <- init_polis_project(file.path(tempdir(), "polis_demo"), quiet = TRUE)
clear_cache(proj, quiet = TRUE)
